articles.title: Backstage 1.55 Adds Scaffolder Task Recovery and Removes Deprecated Catalog APIs
articles.summary:
The Backstage project has released version 1.55 of its open-source developer portal framework, adding automatic recovery for Software Template tasks that crash or time out. The release also removes a set of deprecated catalog APIs and moves the search module to Elasticsearch 8, so platform teams have several breaking changes to work through before they upgrade.
Task recovery sits behind a new scaffolder.taskRecovery configuration section. When it is enabled, the scaffolder resumes a task from the last completed step, keeps task secrets until the task reaches a terminal state and persists completed step outputs so later steps can read them. The release notes warn that actions used by recovered tasks should be idempotent or use checkpoints, because a resumed task can run an action a second time. The new section replaces three experimental flags, which still work as fallbacks.
The feature responds to a long-standing request. In April 2025, on a GitHub issue tracking scaffolder task retries, Manoj Azad wrote, "Currently, having to re-run the entire scaffolder process can be not only inconvenient but also problematic from a technical standpoint." The 1.55 feature covers tasks interrupted by a crash or time-out, which addresses part of that request.
Workspace serialisation is optional and needs a separate provider module. The new database provider has a 50 MB limit and is intended for development, and the release notes point production installations to the GCP module or a similar e…

articles.title: Record historique sur Mars : le rover Perseverance de la NASA vient d'entrer dans les annales
articles.summary:
Près de 5 ans et demi après son arrivée sur Mars, le rover Perseverance a établi un record : celui de la plus longue distance parcourue sur un autre astre que la Terre, c’est-à-dire sur la Lune ou sur Mars. Avec ses 45,22 km au compteur, il a dépassé la distance parcourue par le rover Opportunity sur la planète rouge. Le rover soviétique Lunokhod 2 occupe quant à lui toujours la troisième place de ce classement. La NASA ayant prolongé la mission de Perseverance, celui-ci va pouvoir consolider sa première place dans ce classement, mais attention, les prochaines missions lunaires se rapprochent.
Le rover Perseverance établit un record historique
Ce 11 octobre 2026, alors qu’il entamait son 2 006e jour d’exploration de Mars, le rover Perseverance de la NASA a établi un record tout simplement historique. En effet, il a atteint 45,22 km parcourus sur la planète rouge, devenant ainsi le véhicule ayant parcouru la plus longue distance sur la surface d’un autre astre que la Terre. Le précédent record était détenu par le rover Opportunity, avec ses 45,16 km parcourus sur Mars en près de… 15 ans. Perseverance a, quant à lui, mis cinq ans et demi pour parcourir ses 45,22 km. Notons que le rover soviétique Lunokhod 2 occupe toujours la troisième place de ce classement, avec 39 km parcourus sur la Lune en 1973.

articles.title: 1 500 kW et plein en 5 minutes : les bornes monstres de BYD débarquent en Europe — Frandroid
articles.summary:
Avec l’autonomie, la recharge est encore un point qui peut faire peur aux acheteurs de voitures électriques. En effet, ils craignent de ne pas trouver de borne, mais aussi d’y passer trop de temps. Les choses ont pourtant fortement évolué au fil des années, et remplir la batterie d’une auto ne prend parfois pas plus d’une quinzaine de minutes. Les constructeurs multiplient les bornes toujours plus puissantes, et BYD fait partie des plus avancés : en mars 2026, le constructeur chinois a présenté la deuxième génération de ses bornes de recharge ultrarapide.
Baptisées Flash Charging, ces dernières sont capables de délivrer une puissance maximale de 1 500 kW. Ainsi, il est possible de charger une auto de 10 à 70 % en 5 minutes et d’atteindre 97 % en 9 minutes. Le tout à condition que la voiture soit équipée de la batterie Blade 2.0, ce qui est par exemple le cas de la Denza Z9 GT et du nouveau BYD Atto 8. Nous avons déjà pu tester ces bornes, mais elles ne sont pas encore très nombreuses en Europe.
Mais ce sera très bientôt le cas, comme l’a confirmé le constructeur chinois au Mondial de l’auto de Paris, qui a ouvert ses portes à la presse ce lundi 12 octobre. D’après ses responsables, interrogés sur le salon par le site Car News China, la firme prévoit d’installer 100 bornes Flash Charging en Europe d’ici à la fin de l’année 2026. BYD a déjà installé la première en Allemagne en juin, et d’autres sont en service ailleurs en Europe, notamment au Royaume-Uni.

articles.title: Chrome, Firefox Updates Patch 114 Flaws as Mozilla Unveils Firefox Enterprise
articles.summary:
Google and Mozilla on Tuesday announced fresh Chrome and Firefox updates that resolve 114 vulnerabilities.
The Chrome update was rolled out with fixes for 37 security defects, including seven critical-severity memory issues: a buffer overflow in ANGLE and six use-after-free issues in Browser, PDF, Network, Core, SVG, and Media.
Use-after-free weaknesses represented the majority of the 29 high-severity bugs addressed with the browser refresh. The single medium-severity flaw on the list is also a use-after-free bug.
Per Google’s advisory, at least 15 of the vulnerabilities were reported by Xinyang Ge (Anthropic), assisted by Claude, and no bug bounty reward will be paid for them. Google found 12 security defects.
Google says it handed out $1,000 for a high-severity issue reported by an external researcher, and has yet to disclose the reward amounts for the remaining external reports.
Rolling out as versions 155.0.8059.79/.80 for Windows and macOS, and as version 155.0.8059.79 for Linux, the browser refresh arrived on the same day that Google announced higher bug bounty rewards for some Chrome vulnerabilities.
On Tuesday, Mozilla released Firefox 158 with patches for 77 security defects, most of which were discovered by Mozilla (40) and Amy Burnett of OpenAI (9).
The update resolves 30 high-severity use-after-free, sandbox escape, privilege escalation, information disclosure, incorrect boundary, race condition, JIT miscompilation, and integer overflow bugs.

articles.summary:
Le marché chinois des puces IA est important pour NVIDIA. Mais avec les contraintes imposées par Washington, la firme de Jensen Huang recule logiquement en 2026.
Faut-il ou non laisser la Chine acheter les puissants GPU de NVIDIA, destinés à entraîner les modèles d'IA ? Pour Jensen Huang, patron de NVIDIA, la réponse a toujours été évidemment oui, le milliardaire arguant que couper l'accès à la Chine ne ferait que la rendre plus indépendante, avec le développement de solutions alternatives locales. La part de marché de NVIDIA dans les accélérateurs IA en Chine chute fortement en un an

articles.title: Typographic Intelligence: Warum Designsysteme im KI-Zeitalter nicht mehr ausreichen
articles.summary:
Typographic Intelligence: Warum Designsysteme nicht mehr ausreichen
Designsysteme haben in den vergangenen Jahren grundlegend verändert, wie Unternehmen gestalten. Standardisierte Komponenten, Muster und Assets helfen Teams, schneller zu arbeiten, Inhalte effizient zu skalieren und Marken über unterschiedliche Kanäle hinweg konsistent zu führen. Sie schaffen einen verlässlichen Rahmen, innerhalb dessen Kreativteams schnell produzieren können.
Generative KI treibt diese Entwicklung erheblich voran. Erste Entwürfe und Mock-ups entstehen innerhalb weniger Minuten. Über die entsprechende technische Infrastruktur lassen sie sich fast unmittelbar teilen, prüfen und weiterentwickeln. Doch diese Geschwindigkeit legt eine neue Schwachstelle offen. Während sich die Produktion nahezu beliebig beschleunigen lässt, können Menschen nicht im gleichen Tempo prüfen, bewerten und einordnen, in dem KI neue Varianten produziert. Der neue Engpass ist deshalb nicht die Erstellung von Content, sondern die fundierte Entscheidung darüber, was davon wirklich gut, richtig und markengerecht ist.
Was wir brauchen, sind Entscheidungssysteme
Hier setzt das Konzept der „Typographic Intelligence“ an. Es beschreibt das Zusammenspiel von Kreativität, Technologie, Governance und menschlicher Urteilskraft. Ein wichtiger Bestandteil sind klare Strukturen dafür, wie Entscheidungen getroffen werden, wer die notwendige Expertise einbringt und an welchen Stellen menschliches Urteilsvermögen gefragt ist.

articles.title: Karnataka govt cautious on use of AI in governance: Priyank Kharge
articles.summary:
Karnataka govt cautious on use of AI in governance: Priyank Kharge
The Minister for Home, IT, BT & E-Governance, Govt of Karnataka, said the government will first look at responsible use of AI before deploying the technology in governance.
The Karnataka government is being very cautious about using artificial intelligence (AI) in governance as it first needs to understand how this technology can be used responsibly, said Priyank Kharge, Minister for Home, IT, BT & E-Governance, Government of Karnataka.
During a fireside chat with Shradha Sharma, Founder & CEO, YourStory and The Bharat Project, at Techsparks 2026, Kharge remarked that the state government's cautiousness stems from the fact it owns an enormous amount of data across multiple sectors. “While I keep data privacy as part of the core and use models to develop agents or solutions, governance is very important,” the minister said.
However, this does not mean that the state government will not use AI in governance. The minister said the technology is being leveraged for basic issues such as citizen grievances, health, and mobility. He also said the government has set up a committee to study how to use AI responsibly in governance.
The minister highlighted that the Karnataka government is focused on building the much-needed skill base for AI and is engaged with several companies on this. “One knows how these models (AI) are going rogue; so we are cautious, but at the same time we are investing heavily in skilling,” he s…

articles.title: Un italiano ha entrado en el Libro Guinness de los Récords al convertir un Fiat Panda en el coche más estrecho del mundo
articles.summary:
Aparcar en un hueco imposible siempre ha sido la promesa de los coches pequeños, pero ningún fabricante se atrevió a tanto. El italiano Andrea Marazzi decidió llevar la búsqueda de aparcamiento al extremo más absurdo posible modificando un Fiat Panda de 1993.
Un récord Guinness sobre ruedas. Con su creación, Marazzi se ganó un puesto en el Libro Guinness de los Récords como creador del coche conducible más estrecho del mundo. La idea del proyecto surgió en 2024 cuando llegó un Fiat Panda en sorprendente buen estado al desguace de su familia. Marazzi decidió darle una segunda vida y, tras un año de trabajo, convirtió aquel utilitario en algo difícil de imaginar: un coche de tan sólo 50,2 centímetros de ancho.
Amor por un clásico popular. El Panda es un auténtico icono cultural en Italia. El propio Marazzi siente devoción por este modelo y suele acudir a la concentración anual "Panda a Pandino", cerca de la localidad de Pandino, donde los aficionados celebran su legado. Al tener un ejemplar a mano en el taller, vio la ocasión perfecta para experimentar.

articles.title: SA's KhayaHR builds AI-first workforce platform for frontline economy - Disrupt Africa
articles.summary:
South African startup KhayaHR is building an AI-first workforce platform for the country’s frontline economy, and has already signed up more than 12,000 workers since launching in May.
Founded by Jacques Roux, KhayaHR gives workers a portable digital workforce passport. Employers can use it to find, assess, hire and then manage frontline staff in one place.
“Most recruitment technology assumes that candidates already have formal CVs, established digital histories and easily verifiable employment records,” Roux told Disrupt Africa.
“That assumption excludes many frontline workers. Their work experience may be informal, references fragmented, certificates stored as photographs or paper documents, and availability known only through personal networks or WhatsApp groups.”
The worker passport holds identity and right-to-work confirmation, skills, experience, references, employer recommendations, certificates, availability, and optional voice or video introductions. Workers cannot publish a profile until their identity and right to work in South Africa have been confirmed.

In February 2007, a US military helicopter carrying blood to a field hospital was shot down in Iraq, killing all seven crew members. The mission was a reminder of the risks of transporting blood, which has a limited shelf life and is often in short supply.
Now, a $73 million DARPA effort aims to create shelf-stable versions of plasma, platelets, and red blood cells. The idea is to develop dried blood products that can be stored for long periods and deployed quickly on the battlefield.
The project aims to have bags of dried blood products deployed in the field by 2029. But getting it all done will be tough, and researchers still have major questions about the safety and effectiveness of synthetic alternatives.

articles.title: Anthropic warns self-replicating AI could spread to your smart devices

Rockstar plans to release the PC version of Grand Theft Auto VI as soon as Q1 2027, according to a GamesBeat report citing four industry sources. Rockstar has not responded to requests for comment, and there's no official announcement yet either.

One of the most compelling capabilities of the Antigravity SDK is hybrid agent orchestration, which adapts Google's proposed Architect-Builder pattern to a mixed cloud-local compute environment.
According to the Architect-Builder pattern, one primary, high-context AI agent, the architect, holds the macro-level system view, including dependencies, architectural guardrails, and detailed specifications or implementation plans. articles.title: Ghostscript flaw lets hackers hijack servers via PDF uploads
articles.summary:
A critical heap buffer overflow vulnerability (CVE-2026-39919) in the Ghostscript interpreter and rendering engine could allow remote code execution through specially crafted PDF files.
The flaw was discovered on August 23 by researchers at Defiant's platform Wordfence using their Argus AI-powered system.
Ghostscript is a PostScript and PDF interpreter that can render PDFs as images, generate thumbnails for previews, and optimize PDF files by compressing embedded images and removing unnecessary font data.
When generating a PDF thumbnail, WordPress can use the PHP Imagick extension to call ImageMagick, which launches Ghostscript.
A specially crafted PDF file containing a JPEG 2000 image can trigger incorrect handling of low-bit-depth samples and mismatched component resolutions.
Using Argus, the researchers developed two exploits for CVE-2026-39919 that force Ghostscript to write 1,024 bytes into a 256-byte buffer, corrupting nearby memory and leading to unauthenticated remote code execution in a WordPress deployment.
Wordfence focused on WordPress systems, but notes that the flaw affects any online system running Ghostscript 9.21 through 10.07.1 and is exploitable if the payload is adjusted to the environment.
The researchers tested ten Linux environments, including Debian, Ubuntu, Fedora, Alpine, and AlmaLinux, as well as an official WordPress Docker image snapshot, and found that all contained the vulnerable code.

Años más tarde, en 2003, un nuevo análisis apuntó también a que hay patrones acústicos específicos para las emociones. Con todo esto sacamos como conclusión que cuando el sistema nervioso se acelera, el volumen sube.

articles.title: Helix Carbon says it can make iron cheaper by recycling blast furnace pollution | TechCrunch
articles.summary:
The iron and steel industries are among the biggest polluters in the world. Plenty of startups have tried to cut the industry’s emissions, mostly by developing new ways to make the metals. Helix Carbon thinks those startups have been going about it all wrong.
“Any attempt to decarbonize the steel industry without dealing with the blast furnace is not going to work,” David Brown, Helix Carbon’s co-founder and CEO, told TechCrunch. A blast furnace is the giant furnace that turns iron ore into the iron used to make steel. Rather than replace blast furnaces, Helix wants to clean them up. Its approach promises to slash the steel industry’s carbon emissions while boosting profit margins for iron producers, a rare win-win for a dirty industrial process.
Blast furnaces have made iron for centuries, using coke, a processed form of coal, to help turn raw iron ore (iron bound up with oxygen) into metallic iron. The burning coke supplies heat for the reaction but doesn’t take part in it directly. Instead, carbon monoxide produced from the combustion does the work of reducing the iron, meaning stripping away its oxygen atoms.
The process releases tremendous amounts of carbon dioxide, or CO2, which is normally dumped straight into the atmosphere. But Helix Carbon has devised a way to turn that waste carbon dioxide into carbon monoxide and recycle it back into the blast furnace.

articles.title: Composable Commerce: Inside Shipt’s Kit Platform
articles.summary:
Key Takeaways
- A commerce platform tends to age better when it is built from a small number of first-class entities that reference each other rather than duplicate data between them. The pull to introduce a new entity for every new use case is constant, and it usually signals that the existing model needs to flex rather than grow.
- When a feature has to satisfy several independent constraints at once — which locations can serve a customer, which offerings are enabled where, which categories carry extra eligibility rules — treating the problem as an intersection of independently-evaluated sets scales better than threading conditional logic through a single workflow.
- Grouping related items under a shared identity, with its own completeness guarantees, keeps a bundled offering from silently degrading into something that no longer matches what was promised to the customer.
- Regulated or constrained product categories are easier to support safely when their constraints are modeled as a distinct type carrying its own rules, rather than as flags scattered through a shared code path. New categories then become additive, rather than compounding the complexity of existing ones.
- When a fully safe editing workflow is not realistic within a launch deadline, a layered set of lighter-weight guards can capture most of the risk reduction at a fraction of the engineering cost — often enough of a trade-off to ship safely under real time pressure.

articles.title: La NASA ha fotografiado desde el espacio un gigantesco cráter en Australia con forma de araña
articles.summary:
El 13 de octubre de 2026, la imagen del día del NASA Earth Observatory fue una instantánea fascinante tomada por el satélite Landsat 9 desde el cielo de Australia. En ella se ve el cráter Araña (Spider crater), una deformación del terreno ubicada en la región de Kimberley, en Australia Occidental. Como su propio nombre indica, tiene una curiosa forma de araña que ha llamado la atención de los científicos desde hace años. Y es que, en realidad, esta estructura llamó por primera vez la atención de los geólogos en los años 50 del siglo pasado.
En unos inicios se pensó que podría tener origen volcánico, pero las investigaciones posteriores la han descrito como un cráter de impacto. Aún hay muchos misterios a su alrededor, pero estos ya no obsesionan solo a los científicos. La foto de la NASA ha hecho que personas ajenas a la ciencia de todo el mundo se interesen y se maravillen por ella.
Las cifras. En la imagen de la NASA, tomada el pasado 20 de septiembre de 2026, se ve una estructura de unos 4 kilómetros de ancho. Sin embargo, este es solo el centro del cráter completo, cuyas dimensiones totales son de 13x11 kilómetros. Esto incluye las patas de la araña, formadas por crestas claras de arenisca.

Anthropic warns of self-replicating AI worm threat that doesn't need data centers to self-improve and spread — current deployment is impractical but could become a worry as tech improves
The threat is real, but still in the future, at least for now.
Anthropic's Frontier Red Team has demonstrated two components of a potential AI-powered worm that, if key issues with the practical implementation are resolved, could spread across consumer devices including inexpensive Android TV boxes and smart appliances, hypothetically without relying on datacenter infrastructure. The experiments show that AI agents can configure inference across different hardware platforms and orchestrate replication across a network. There are still some serious limitations, though, particularly around the gap between the capabilities of today's models versus the hardware constraints of potential targets.
In its October 12 report, titled "AI models may be capable of self-replicating without access to a datacenter," Anthropic examines a potential class of malware called a weight-based replicator. Rather than distributing conventional executable code, it would propagate AI model weights alongside the software infrastructure needed to run inference on compromised devices, and it's not pure theory, either.

Smaller models are already capable of hijacking unfamiliar hardware
- Anthropic warns that self-replicating AI worms could become feasible by the end of the year
- These AI worms could hijack hardware ranging from IoT devices to data centers
- Smaller models are already capable of adapting to unfamiliar hardware and self-replication
Anthropic has warned self-replication could become feasible for small AI models on internet-of-things (IoT) devices in just a matter of months.
This could be a big problem because a self-replicating AI model does not have a centralized off-switch and could hop networks to discover other IoT hardware to further replicate without human control.
Anthropic warns these AI worms could use multiple compromised IoT devices to run inference while carrying its model weights with it as it reproduces. IoT devices would be a prime target for this worm because they are “cheap and typically poorly defended,” the company says.
Small AI models could spread quickly
To test the viability of a self-replicating AI worm, Anthropic researchers ran Gemma4-26B-A4B - a 25 billion parameter model - across 15 inexpensive off-brand Android TV boxes at a cost of around $55 each. Once networked together the TV boxes were able to run distributed inference, solidifying the proof-of-concept.

Los asistentes de IA empezaron a realizar transacciones en nombre de las personas, pero su funcionamiento no es del todo predecible y pueden terminar comprando algo distinto a lo pedido. Eso abre la puerta a compras no autorizadas y a disputas con las tarjetas de crédito.

Cómo funciona el nuevo sistema anti compras innecesarias
El esquema arranca con una Create Intent API, una herramienta que capta la instrucción de compra del usuario junto con las condiciones que haya puesto, como el nombre del comercio, el presupuesto máximo o preferencias del producto.

articles.title: How to Find Resilience Bugs in Systems that Don't Exist
articles.summary:
Transcript
Hillel Wayne: I have a bit of a weird job. Companies pay me to find bugs in systems that don't exist, or more specifically, don't yet exist. They come to me with some idea for a system they want, but they're also afraid the system might lose them customers if it goes wrong, and they ask me to look at their description and tell them if there's a really bad bug somewhere. Growing up in extreme programming and agile shops, this felt verboten to me when I first started doing it. After all, we all know that we can only find bugs at the very end when we have the whole coding system that we can test, possibly in production. It's actually a relatively simple process that all of us can do. To show you that this is just even possible in the first place, let's walk through the thing doer.
The thing doer does a thing. It first checks to see if the thing has been marked done. Then it marks the thing as done. Then it actually does the thing. Would anybody like to shout out the problem with this thing doer? Yes, there, you found a bug in something that didn't exist. The problem with this is that we all know this is not how an actual system works. The actual system is going to look like this. Doing the thing might fail. If it fails, we have to retry. If we retry, we get to this point where we check the thing is marked done, and see, it's been marked done. Then we just never do the thing. That's a bug. Le récent événement « Welcom Home » ne changera malheureusement pas la situation pour les iPhone avec iOS 27, l’iPad et l’Apple Watch. La marque à la pomme prend un virage majeur dans la domotique en plaçant Siri AI au cœur de son écosystème, ce qui a pour conséquence de priver la France (et le reste de l’Union européenne) du HomeView, son nouvel appareil pour la maison connectée.
La décision n’est pas vraiment une surprise et le couperet était tombé dès le 8 juin, le jour même de la présentation de Siri AI. Apple annonçait alors que l’assistant ne serait pas proposé dans l’Union européenne avec iOS 27 et iPadOS 27, en invoquant le Digital Markets Act (DMA), le règlement européen sur les marchés numériques. L’Apple Watch suit par ricochet, puisque Siri AI sur watchOS 27 exige un iPhone jumelé qui en dispose. Craig Federighi, patron du logiciel chez Apple, se disait alors « profondément déçu » et reconnaissait que l’entreprise n’avait « actuellement aucun calendrier » pour un déploiement sur iPhone et iPad. Même les développeurs installés dans l’UE ne peuvent pas tester les fonctions de Siri AI dans leurs apps iOS.
Pourquoi le Mac y a droit, et pas l’iPhone
La différence tient à la façon dont Bruxelles applique le DMA. La Commission européenne a désigné iOS et iPadOS comme des « services de plateforme essentiels » d’Apple, ce qui les soumet à des obligations d’interopérabilité. …

articles.summary:
Brad Smith, presidente de Microsoft, ha prestado declaración recientemente sobre cómo está el panorama de la IA en términos de regulación. La cosa no está para tirar cohetes, y el propio Smith sostiene que hasta un cartón de leche tiene más protocolos de seguridad que los mayores sistemas de IA más potentes del mundo (que por otra parte, no es un punto tan polémico teniendo en cuenta que es algo que ingerimos en nuestro día a día). Smith pide normas globales precisamente en un momento en que la Casa Blanca prefiere que la industria se autorregule.
Choque frontal. Smith representa una de las posiciones más importantes de una de las empresas más profundamente involucradas en la IA. articles.title: Hirudo Android malware replaces banking apps to evade security checks
articles.summary:
A new Android malware called Hirudo steals bank account credentials by replacing legitimate banking apps with modified versions that disable security checks.
Researchers identified malicious copies of eight banking apps that use a hooking engine to bypass app-signature, Accessibility, and Play Integrity checks by substituting certificate information or returning empty lists.
Threat actors can use Hirudo to steal credentials, remotely control infected phones in real time, collect messages, capture screenshots, and record audio.
A report today from mobile security company ThreatFabric notes that Hirudo has been observed impersonating at least seven Indonesian banks, but the malware also targets financial organizations in China, India, Mexico, Morocco, and Thailand.
The malware is typically delivered via apps for shopping (Shopora), adult content (1V1 X), or short drama (ZoyaTV, KoiShort) that appear legitimate and provide the promised functionality.
The researchers say that these apps act as malware loaders for Hirudo, showing a fake “update” notification that leads to permission-granting prompts, including for Accessibility services
Once installed, Hirudo launches the real banking app’s uninstaller, downloads a patched copy, and abuses its Accessibility permission to install it.
ThreatFabric explains that this is a delicate, risky process for the malware, since the victim can interrupt it at two points.

articles.title: Seulement 11 mètres de haut : pourquoi le premier vol de la fusée réutilisable RV-X de la JAXA est aussi le dernier
articles.summary:
C’était cet été, et l’agence spatiale japonaise (JAXA) a mis en ligne ce mercredi 14 octobre une vidéo qui raconte de bout en bout le premier vol de RV-X. Sous ce nom se cache un « petit » démonstrateur de fusée réutilisable, qui montre tout l’intérêt qu’a la JAXA pour une approche à la SpaceX : tirer des fusées, les récupérer et les remettre sur le circuit ensuite.
Ce vol, qui remonte au 11 juillet, a eu lieu au centre d’essais de Noshiro, dans la préfecture d’Akita, au nord du Japon. Dans la vidéo, on voit la préparation, le vol et ce qui se passe une fois l’engin posé. Pendant la phase de vol, RV-X est monté à environ 11 mètres et s’est décalé de 16 mètres en restant vertical. Le vol a duré une quarantaine de secondes.
Onze mètres de haut, ça peut faire sourire, quand on compare au Starship de SpaceX : l’immense lanceur de l’entreprise américaine en est maintenant à faire des vols orbitaux. Mieux que ça : il devrait bientôt y avoir le premier test de capture de l’étage supérieur par la tour de lancement (le propulseur, lui, a déjà été rattrapé).
Mais c’est oublier que SpaceX aussi a commencé modestement. Le Starhopper, premier engin d’essai du programme Starship, ressemblait beaucoup à ce RV-X : un prototype extrêmement incomplet. Lors de son premier vol libre, en juillet 2019, il ne s’était élevé que d’une vingtaine de mètres.

articles.title: Dunkle Energie: So könnten schwache Radiowellen sein Geheimnis lüften
articles.summary:
Dunkle Energie: Ein schwaches Radiosignal aus der Frühzeit des Universums könnte ihr Geheimnis lüften
Was steckt hinter Dunkler Energie? Dies ist eines der großen Rätsel der Kosmologie. Die unsichtbare, hypothetische Form der Energie gilt als verantwortlich für die Ausdehnung des Universums, nachdem der erste Schub durch den Big Bang abgeklungen war.
Neuer Weg zum Verständnis von Dunkler Energie?
Direkt nachgewiesen werden konnte die Dunkle Energie, die fast 70 Prozent der Energiedichte des Universums ausmachen soll, noch nicht. Ein Forschungsteam könnte aber nun einen Weg gefunden haben, Dunkle Energie künftig besser zu verstehen.
Die Resultate ihrer Forschung haben die Wissenschaftler:innen in gleich zwei Papern vorgestellt, die beide in der Fachzeitschrift The Astrophysical Journal erschienen sind.
Analyse von neutralem Wasserstoff
Die Forschenden haben mit dem Radioteleskop Canadian Hydrogen Intensity Mapping Experiment (CHIME) nach Spuren von kosmischem Wasserstoff gesucht. Genauer gesagt nach neutralem atomaren Wasserstoff, der nicht ionisiert und also elektrisch ungeladen ist.
Neutraler Wasserstoff sendet eine Radiostrahlung mit einer Wellenlänge von etwa 21 Zentimetern aus. Durch die Expansion des Universums wird die Strahlung auf dem Weg zur Erde zu niedrigeren Frequenzen verschoben.

The US exported the most drones over the past few years — but the second-biggest exporter might surprise you
US and Iran account for 86% of global military drone exports
- The US exported 7,592 military drones, narrowly ahead of Iran's 6,800
- Iran overtook America in 2025 after US deliveries dropped to 402
- Russia received 99% of Iran's exported drones, mostly Shahed-136 attack systems
The United States exported the most military drones between 2022 and 2025, narrowly beating Iran, which ranked second worldwide during the period.
Data from the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute (SIPRI) records 7,592 American exports against 6,800 Iranian deliveries, while Germany ranked a distant third with 1,000 exports.
Together, the US and Iran accounted for 86% of global exports, with Ukraine receiving 95% of American shipments while Russia got 99% of Iran’s deliveries, most of which were Shahed-136 one-way attack drones.
Iran overtakes the US as exports shift
Although Washington maintained the lead across most of the period, annual figures changed significantly in 2025, when Iranian deliveries exceeded American shipments.
Iran exported 2,002 drones that year, compared with 402 delivered by the United States.
The decline of American shipments is due to the suspension of military assistance to Ukraine, which had received most US exports during the preceding years.

Intel bets the next phase of AI belongs to the rightsized system, not the biggest one
For three years, artificial intelligence infrastructure has been dominated by one idea: Bigger is better. Bigger models, bigger clusters, and bigger checks written to a small group of suppliers. Underneath is a strategic argument worth attention: Intel believes inference, not training, will define enterprise AI economics and that agentic AI will bring the CPU back to the center of the data center. If that’s right, Intel’s turnaround gets a second engine at exactly the right time.

Called WordCraft, GridCraft, and DeckCraft, respectively, the open-source applications are written in Rust with Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5, as the Adobe replicas were, and are available for download under MIT or Apache 2.0 licenses. WordCraft reads and writes .docx, the native file format of Microsoft Word. It also supports a range of other formats, including .odt, .rtf, .html, .md, and .txt, and can import the legacy .doc format. It can export PDFs with real, selectable text, links, and bookmarks, too. Thomas noted that spelling, grammar, and many other critical features work offline.

articles.title: Une supernova presque en direct : le télescope James Webb a vu une étoile quelques jours après son explosion - Numerama
articles.summary:
Vues depuis la Terre, les supernovae peuvent ressembler à des étoiles ordinaires. Pourtant, il s’agit de l’explosion extrêmement puissante d’une étoile en fin de vie. Pour les plus massives, le cœur s’effondre sur lui-même avant que l’astre ne vole en éclats.
Généralement, la lumière émise lors de l’explosion reste visible quelques semaines, voire quelques mois pour les plus massives, et il faut être réactif pour pouvoir capter le maximum de données avant que le tout devienne invisible.
Dans une étude pas encore relue par des pairs, parue le 29 septembre sur le serveur arXiv et repérée par le site Phys.org, une équipe menée par l’astronome Ming-Yang Zhuang, de l’Université de l’Illinois à Urbana-Champaign, fait état d’une probable supernova détectée seulement quatre à dix jours après l’explosion. Le signal se nomme AT 2026abck et se trouve extrêmement loin dans l’Univers, à un redshift (le décalage de sa lumière vers le rouge, qui trahit son éloignement) de 5,017, ce qui signifie que lorsque la lumière a été émise, l’Univers était âgé d’un peu plus d’un milliard d’années.
Le télescope James Webb passe et repasse
Ce type de trouvaille aussi loin dans le temps est assez rare. On compte seulement 200 supernovae découvertes à des distances équivalentes autour d’un redshift de 4. Les phénomènes de lentilles gravitationnelles, qui font un effet loupe, sont particulièrement pratiques pour pouvoir repérer ces sources très lumineuses mais aussi extrêmement lointaines et donc difficile…

articles.title: TFG London cyberattack disrupts systems at Hobbs and Whistles retailers

TFG London detected a cybersecurity incident that impacted IT systems used by the Phase Eight, Hobbs, and Whistles premium fashion brands.
The company disclosed earlier today that several IT systems remain unavailable, although physical stores remain open for customers.
According to the press release, the incident has not affected the group’s other brands, Inside Story and White Stuff, or its operations in Australia and Africa.
TFG London is the UK subsidiary of South Africa’s The Foschini Group, which owns the aforementioned five fashion and homeware brands.
As of mid-2026, the group operated 649 retail locations globally and reported annual sales of £488 million ($646M).
The company said it detected the cyberattack on October 11 and immediately activated its incident response and business continuity plans, bringing in external cybersecurity experts to help contain the threat.
TFG London is investigating whether any customer information has been compromised, and says it will notify affected individuals or organizations if it data has been affected.
BleepingComputer could not find any threat actor publicly claiming the TFG London breach.
The incident at TFG London comes shortly after another UK fashion retailer, ASOS, suffered a data breach after hackers sent push notifications to users of its mobile app.

articles.title: Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse is a successful resurrection, but not without faults
articles.summary:
This year has been quite the story for dormant platformer franchises, especially Castlevania.
It’s been nearly 20 years since we’ve had a single-player Metroidvania-style Castlevania game. My introduction to the franchise was with Symphony of the Night over a decade ago, and since then, I was hooked. It’s a prime example of a sublime platformer game, with perfect controls, interesting world-building and a rich atmosphere.
Since then, I’ve played through the various Castlevania games led by Koji Igarashi, who spearheaded the Metroidvania titles, including his spiritual successor, Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night. Despite the lack of Castlevania video game releases, though, the franchise itself was still active through various other media, including the fantastic Netflix TV series and video game collaborations.
The most famous of these collaborations was with Dead Cells, a roguelite (where players get randomized gear during each run) game inspired by the Metroidvania genre. After rave reviews (though I personally haven’t played it), it felt fitting for Konami to give Castlevania the “Sonic Mania” treatment with the creators of Dead Cells taking the helm for the newest iteration, Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse.
How does it compare to its previous iterations or even the endless Metroidvania games out there now? Well, it has its highs and lows that will ultimately determine whether you really jive with it.

However, according to the Federal Trade Commission and the attorneys general of seven states, Shkreli has “flagrantly and repeatedly” violated that ban nearly the entire time—allegedly by trading stock in dozens of drug companies and discussing the industry during livestreams on social media.
On Tuesday, the FTC and the seven states asked a federal judge to hold Shkreli in contempt for the alleged violations. The states include New York, California, Illinois, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, and Virginia—the same states that joined the FTC in suing Shkreli in 2020 over the “elaborate anticompetitive scheme” involving the anti-parasitic drug, Daraprim. The scheme raised the price from $17.50 per pill to $750 per pill virtually overnight, while blocking generic competitors from entering the market.

Science Corporation CEO Max Hodak announced that the company has implanted its vision-restoring chip, PRIMA, into its first patient with Stargardt disease, an inherited eye disease that gradually destroys central vision. Hodak, the former president and co-founder of Neuralink, the brain implant company, explained onstage at TechCrunch Disrupt how the company’s work with PRIMA fits into its broader pursuit of a novel brain-computer interface (BCI).
“The retina is part of the central nervous system,” Hodak said. “We consider cochlear implants, retinal prostheses, motor prostheses, these are all different types of BCIs.”
Hodak outlined a vision in which BCIs expand into a wide range of medical technology applications, rather than simply being a way to control computers.
While PRIMA is commercially available in Europe for patients who’ve lost their sight to geographic atrophy, an advanced form of age-related macular degeneration, the company believes its approach can be applied to multiple diseases, including Stargardt disease, which is currently considered incurable.
Stargardt disease affects the outer retina, causing the gradual death of the eye’s light-sensing cells while potentially sparing the inner retina, the part that passes visual signals onto the brain. It causes a central blind spot that gradually enlarges over time. Approximately 150,000 people worldwide have lost vision due to the disease.

articles.title: Ivanti warns of Connect Secure zero-day exploited in attacks
articles.summary:
Ivanti urged customers on Tuesday to immediately patch an actively exploited zero-day vulnerability in the Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS) remote access gateway.
Formerly known as Pulse Connect Secure and originally Juniper Pulse, the enterprise-grade ICS SSL VPN provides remote employees, contractors, and hybrid workforces with secure access to corporate and cloud resources.
Tracked as CVE-2026-104935, this high-severity authentication bypass zero-day affects ICS versions 22.8R2.4 and earlier, 25.1.2.2 and earlier, and 25.1.1.1 and earlier.
Remote threat actors without privileges can exploit CVE-2026-104935 in low-complexity attacks that don't require user interaction to execute arbitrary commands on targeted ICS appliances.
"At the time of disclosure, Ivanti is aware of limited exploitation in the wild. We are working directly with those organizations while making information, updates and remediation available to the broader customer community. If you are running one of the impacted versions, Ivanti recommends you act immediately," Ivanti said.
"Customers should review the security advisory, upgrade to the fixed version as soon as possible, and run the Integrity Checker Tool regularly."
Internet threat watchdog Shadowserver now tracks over 5,500 ICS instances exposed online, but there is no information on how many are honeypots or have already been secured against ongoing attacks.
Exploited since at least October 1

Safety researchers continue to warn that a large volume of AI-generated explicit content is spreading unchecked, while regulators do little to meaningfully stop it.
This non-consensual content is commonly shared in text and direct messages or stored in private clouds where it’s less likely to be detected or reported, a Google co-authored study of Internet users across the United States, Australia, and the United Kingdom found this July. That’s why the “most critical intervention point” remains at the source: the harmful AI tools used to make the fake sexual images, Google researchers concluded.
Yet red-teaming in recent months suggests that as some of the leading AI image generators from Google and OpenAI become more capable, they may be getting worse at blocking explicit outputs.
Raising the red flag are researchers at White Circle, a public benefit corporation backed by senior leaders and researchers from Anthropic, DeepMind, Hugging Face, and OpenAI. It was founded after CEO Denis Shilov posted one of the most famous universal jailbreaks of leading models in October 2024. Bent on breaking models to conduct thorough safety testing, White Circle helps companies detect and deter threats when implementing advanced AI systems that may not always behave as expected.
Testing how well text-to-image models block banned content categories is a key research direction for White Circle, and Shilov thinks their latest findings are “horrifying” enough to share with the public.

articles.title: SAP warns of maximum severity OAuth2 SSRF security flaw

SAP has addressed 20 security flaws across multiple products in its October 2026 security updates, including a maximum-severity vulnerability in the Cloud SDK for Python.
The SAP Python SDK is the official programmatic toolkit for developing AI agents and Python applications on the company's SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) services.
Tracked as CVE-2026-89111, the maximum-severity vulnerability patched this month can be exploited by remote attackers without privileges to steal credentials.
Customers who can't immediately deploy the October 2026 SAP patches can temporarily mitigate the issue by using an allowlist to validate tenant_subdomain values.
"The SAP Cloud SDK for Python contains an OAuth2 SSRF vulnerability affecting multi-tenant BTP applications. An attacker who controls the tenant_subdomain parameter can redirect OAuth2 token requests to an attacker-controlled server, causing client credentials to be exfiltrated," according to a Tuesday advisory.
"Consumer applications can mitigate the vulnerability by validating tenant_subdomain against a known allowlist of registered tenant subdomains before passing it to any SDK call."
Today, SAP also addressed CVE-2026-89110, a critical broken access control vulnerability in the SAP NetWeaver Visual Composer that could let remote attackers with limited privileges fully compromise vulnerable systems.

articles.title: Amperesand Aims to Smooth AI Data Center Power Spikes - EE Times
articles.summary:
Singapore-based solid-state transformer (SST) startup Amperesand aims to help AI data centers smooth the spikes in their electrical demand that can stress power grids.
“When a glitch happens, we don’t just kick off the grid; we actually power the AI load with a battery,” Amperesand CEO Brian Dow told EE Times. “We also can pull power to keep the rate of change in the medium voltage under control.”
Dow noted a recent data center failure he hopes to help prevent: a July 2026 grid disconnection in the U.S. state of Virginia that caused data centers to automatically switch to backup generators, dropping a more-than 3-gigawatt load in seconds that caused power to flicker across the eastern U.S.
“A gigawatt is probably the power consumption of Cincinnati,” Dow said. “It’d be like Cincinnati turning all its lights on and off at every single load, simultaneously.”
SSTs are set to enter AI data centers as traditional transformers made of copper coils and magnetic iron cores struggle to meet rising demands for efficiency, power density, and scalability. Increasing rack power levels and fluctuating AI workloads cause energy losses, thermal challenges, and system complexity, power IC maker Microchip noted. SSTs directly convert medium-voltage grid power like 13.8 kV to 35 kV AC into high-voltage 800 VDC in a single step.

Tally handcrafted its stack from the start, she said, with its own database, its own memory manager, and a programming language invented in-house. Tejas Goenka stressed on the company' founding principle. "The cost post-purchase should be near zero,” he said, recalling the days when releases were shipped with a support team of one.

As reported by La Presse, Antigang, a production from Radio-Canada’s ICI Télé, has had to switch to exclusively using Android phones like Samsung’s Galaxy devices. The reason for that? Apple is very particular about iPhones being used by criminals in media.
Notably, this lines up with what we heard from Knives Out director Rian Johnson a number of years ago. When breaking down a scene from his first Benoit Blanc mystery film, Johnson said Ransom, the character played by Chris Evans, wasn’t allowed to use an iPhone because he is eventually revealed to be the villain. Ransom’s mother, however, Jamie Lee Curtis’ Linda, was able to use one since she was ultimately innocent.
Of course, this is a pretty silly restriction on Apple’s part. Most people wouldn’t even pay attention to what phone a character is using, and fewer still would nonsensically link iPhone usage with criminality. It’s also funny when you consider that per Statcounter data cited by La Presse, 65 per cent of Canadians use an iPhone, so statistically speaking, a criminal would be more likely to be on iOS than Android.

Los precios dependen del objetivo, la duración y las características solicitadas. SolarWinds’ Avior pairs AI agents with deterministic execution for enterprise IT
Observability and information technology management software company SolarWinds Worldwide LLC today unveiled Avior, a standalone agentic artificial intelligence system built to take on first-line operations work for enterprise IT teams.
The launch goes after the reliability problem that comes with letting AI agents act on production systems. SolarWinds argues that an agent producing different outcomes from one run to the next is a liability wherever uptime and security are on the line. Most IT organizations already absorb that cost in outage time and audit exposure, the company said.
Chief Technology Officer Krishna Sai said the design grounds “probabilistic models in deterministic execution.” The models work out what needs doing. A fixed framework of predefined goals and approval controls governs how it gets done, and every workflow can be audited. Those goals draw on 25 years of SolarWinds experience with how IT environments actually behave, Sai said.
SolarWinds’ existing AI assistants, including an AI Agent that entered tech preview for SolarWinds Observability SaaS in October 2025, work inside individual products. The company describes those tools as “bounded by human attention and prompting.” Avior runs as its own application on the SolarWinds Platform and reaches third-party systems through the Model Context Protocol. A segunda opção depende de equipamentos bloqueadores e deverá seguir as condições técnicas definidas pela Agência Nacional de Telecomunicações.
As administrações penitenciárias estaduais e distrital serão responsáveis por identificar os casos e encaminhar informações técnicas. Os pedidos serão enviados por uma plataforma digital do Ministério da Justiça e Segurança Pública, integrada ao Sistema Nacional de Informações Penais (Sisdepen).
Segundo o Art. 6º do decreto, quando um celular for identificado individualmente, a solicitação será encaminhada ao fluxo do Banco Nacional de Celulares com Restrição, com o código IMEI do aparelho. Is the Radeon RX 9070 XT really faster than the GeForce RTX 5090? It's a strange question, we know, but it's one we've been asked quite consistently for a while, so we figured it was time to address it.
Now, you might be thinking that's a pretty dumb question. Why would anyone ask it, and why are we even entertaining the idea? Well, hear us out. Sometimes the RX 9070 XT actually is faster than the RTX 5090, but that doesn't mean it's really the faster GPU. It depends on the circumstances, and as we'll explain, things can get a little complicated.
Understanding Driver Overhead and CPU Bottlenecks
About five years ago, we investigated an issue that saw Radeon GPUs performing up to 30% faster, and sometimes even more, in CPU-limited gaming scenarios. This primarily affected lower-end processors, which were more likely to encounter CPU bottlenecks when gaming. As it turns out, Radeon GPUs generally place less demand on the CPU in these situations, providing additional performance headroom.
In the second part of our Nvidia driver overhead investigation, we demonstrated real examples where the Radeon RX 5600 XT was faster than the RTX 3080. That's pretty alarming considering the RTX 3080 is, on average, around 130% faster than the RX 5600 XT.

articles.title: Patch Tuesday d'octobre : record de 1 411 failles corrigées, dont un zero-day Windows déjà exploité
articles.summary:
Des pirates exploitent une faille de Windows pour contourner la protection chargée de signaler les fichiers venus d’Internet. Microsoft l’a corrigée mardi 13 octobre, dans un Patch Tuesday record de 1 411 vulnérabilités. Pour en dénicher autant, l’éditeur fait travailler l’intelligence artificielle sur le code de ses logiciels.
Microsoft bat son record pour la troisième fois en quatre mois. Après 974 failles corrigées en septembre, l’éditeur a livré mardi des correctifs pour 1 411 vulnérabilités, dont 70 critiques, d’après le décompte de BleepingComputer. Le site a exclu de ce total 348 autres failles, corrigées plus tôt dans le mois dans Azure ou Exchange Server. Trois des 1 411 failles sont des zero-days, et des pirates exploitent l’une d’elles dans Windows Shell, sous la référence CVE-2026-96951. Un attaquant peut s’en servir pour contourner le Mark of the Web. Windows appose ce marqueur sur les fichiers récupérés en ligne, depuis un navigateur ou une messagerie, et affiche un avertissement avant leur ouverture.
Des failles débusquées par les outils d’IA de Microsoft
L’équipe Windows a prévenu ses clients le 9 juillet. Ses ingénieurs, aidés par l’IA, allaient trouver plus de failles et plus vite, et les utilisateurs verraient arriver « un volume plus élevé de mises à jour de sécurité dans chaque publication ». Cinq jours plus tard, Microsoft a signé le plus gros Patch Tuesday de son histoire, avec 622 failles. Ses équipes passent notamment le code de Windows au crible avec…

articles.title: Unos científicos han analizado qué le pasa a nuestros músculos cuando tomamos kéfir y han llegado a ideas sorprendentes
articles.summary:
Los alimentos fermentados son muy buenos para la salud intestinal. Las opciones ricas en proteínas ayudan a generar músculo. Estos dos hechos son bastante conocidos. Ahora bien, ¿pueden los alimentos fermentados ricos en proteínas suponer un beneficio simultáneo para los dos órganos? Alimentos fermentados con proteínas. Un equipo de científicos del King’s College de Londres ha llevado a cabo recientemente una revisión en la que se analiza el contenido de la literatura científica sobre el eje intestino-músculo. Concretamente, la mayoría de estudios del análisis se centran en cómo afectan a la salud los alimentos fermentados ricos en proteínas, como el kéfir, el yogur, el requesón o el tempeh. GTA 6 pode chegar ao PC no início de 2027, diz site
Fontes ouvidas pela GamesBeat indicam lançamento para PC até março, poucos meses após estreia nos consoles.
GTA 6 pode chegar ao PC no primeiro trimestre de 2027, segundo apuração da GamesBeat. O site afirma ter obtido o prazo de quatro fontes da indústria familiarizadas com os planos da Rockstar Games. Se a previsão se concretizar, a edição será lançada poucos meses após as versões de consoles.
A informação foi publicada nesta terça-feira (13/10). Na página oficial do jogo, a Rockstar mantém a data de 19 de novembro de 2026 para os consoles PlayStation 5 e Xbox Series X/S, mas ainda não cita o lançamento do jogo para PCs.
A janela mencionada pela reportagem corresponde ao período entre janeiro e março de 2027, ainda sem um dia específico para o lançamento. A previsão, também repercutida pelo site Eurogamer, representaria uma espera muito menor que a registrada em GTA 5. articles.title: Scientists create super ice that's 10 times stronger than regular ice and almost as tough as concrete
articles.summary:
What just happened? Anyone who's fallen face-first on thick ice will testify that it's pretty strong. But it's nothing compared to a new type of ice created by researchers. The aptly nicknamed super ice is an incredible 10 times stronger under compression than regular frozen water, making it close to the strength of concrete.
Called BioPykrete, the material was developed by a team led by researchers at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem. It combines ice, tiny plant-derived cellulose crystals, and a specially engineered protein. The resulting composite also absorbs around 70 times more energy before breaking than ordinary ice.
Regular ice can fail suddenly as cracks race through it. But BioPykrete deforms and gives way more gradually, potentially making it a more useful building material. So not only can it withstand pressure, it can also avoid shattering without warning.
"We wanted to go beyond simply mixing fibers into ice and instead control how the different materials connect at the molecular level," said Professor Ido Braslavsky, one of the lead researchers.
The cellulose nanocrystals form a three-dimensional network around microscopic pockets of ice during freezing. The protein, called CBM3a-AFPIII, connects the ingredients in a glue-like fashion. One part attaches to ice, while the other binds to cellulose.
The researchers believe that this reinforced network helps stop cracks from spreading freely. Adding the protein doubled both compressive strength and energy absorpt…

AI infrastructure networking is approaching a physical turning point as the copper links that tie GPUs together inside a rack strain under ever-faster signaling speeds. The move to light-based interconnects could redraw the boundaries of what counts as a single AI system.
Cisco Systems Inc. is pressing that transition on several fronts, from new silicon and pluggable optics to an optical standard developed with Nvidia Corp. ScaleFlux bets smarter SSD controllers can break the AI memory bottleneck
AI factories run on graphics processing units that cost a fortune and work at blistering speed, yet those chips increasingly sit idle waiting for data. As the bottleneck moves from compute to memory and storage, NAND flash is being asked to do far more than hold files.
That shift is putting data movement constraints at the center of AI infrastructure planning. A GPU operates at about 20 to 22 terabytes per second, and every tier of the hierarchy below it adds delay, according to Pichai Balaji (pictured), vice president of products and marketing at ScaleFlux Inc.
“When you move to DRAM, it is almost 37 to 40 times slower than what the GPU wants. You go even further down to the storage side, it is almost 800 times slower,” Balaji said. “A bottleneck is created all throughout when the data is moving from the GPU into the memory, into the storage. The bottleneck just gets amplified.”
Balaji spoke with theCUBE Research’s John Furrier at the AI Data Pipeline Forum, during an exclusive broadcast on theCUBE, SiliconANGLE Media’s livestreaming studio. They discussed AI factories, smarter controllers and using NAND flash as active memory for AI workloads. (* Disclosure below.)

Firefox ganha versão paga com controle de dados e IA
Firefox Enterprise reúne navegador e painel de gestão corporativa, com foco comercial. Preços não foram divulgados.
A Mozilla apresentou o Firefox Enterprise, uma plataforma paga que combina o navegador com ferramentas de administração para empresas. A novidade permite gerenciar políticas de segurança, acesso e até uso de ferramentas de inteligência artificial.
Anunciada na segunda-feira (12/10), a novidade é voltada a instituições com exigências de segurança e controle de dados. No início, o foco será em quatro países: França, Alemanha, Áustria e Suíça. A empresa, porém, afirma que a novidade chegará a “outros mercados a seguir”. Os preços não foram informados.
A plataforma centraliza a administração das configurações do navegador. As equipes de TI podem definir regras de segurança, administrar extensões e estabelecer permissões conforme a identidade do funcionário e as condições de segurança do dispositivo.
Segundo a Mozilla, a organização pode manter políticas, chaves e dados de telemetria dentro do ambiente que administra. A plataforma também permite exportar eventos do navegador e ações dos administradores para sistemas de monitoramento de segurança já utilizados pela empresa.
Outro recurso é a prevenção contra perda de dados. A ferramenta permite estabelecer regras por site e ação do usuário, incluindo avisos ou bloqueios para envio e download de arquivos e operações de copiar e colar.

articles.title: Sony pone a la venta una versión más barata de la PlayStation 5, pero no todos la podrán comprar
articles.summary:
Sony presentó una nueva edición de la PlayStation 5 con un precio considerablemente menor al estándar, aunque su venta quedará restringida a Japón. Se trata de la PS5 Digital Edition en color Midnight Black, que saldrá a la venta el 19 de noviembre, la misma fecha en que debuta Grand Theft Auto VI, el título de Rockstar Games más esperado del año.
La consola se comercializará en Japón por 55.000 yenes, equivalentes a unos 380 dólares según la conversión directa, aunque medios especializados también situaron la cifra cercana a los 347 dólares.
El monto representa una diferencia notable frente a los 599 dólares que cuesta actualmente la PS5 Digital Edition estándar en otros mercados, precio que Sony ajustó al alza en marzo de este año. El lanzamiento coincide con un período de aumento generalizado en el costo de las consolas, atribuido a la crisis de memoria, la escasez de componentes, los aranceles comerciales y la inflación. Las proyecciones del sector anticipan nuevas subas para 2027.
Las restricciones que limitan su alcance
El PS5 Midnight Black se basa en una variante exclusiva que Sony ya comercializaba en Japón, por lo que conserva un bloqueo regional: solo admite configuración de idioma japonés y requiere una cuenta de PlayStation Network registrada en esa región. Estas limitaciones impiden que la consola funcione con normalidad fuera del país, lo que reduce de forma significativa la posibilidad de importarla pese a su atractivo precio.

articles.title: OpenAI employee arrested for allegedly hiding recording device in executive meeting room
articles.summary:
What we know so far: In a prime example of the cloak-and-dagger world of tech espionage, a Saudi national has been arrested for allegedly planting a recording device in OpenAI's executive conference room. It's claimed that Abdulrahman Alfozan wrapped the device in toilet paper and inserted it into a USB port on the back of a TV.
The "sophisticated recording device" was discovered by OpenAI on or around September 30 in one of its San Francisco offices. The company determined that it had been planted a few days earlier. Its security team tried to export the microSD card's data but couldn't examine it because it was encrypted.
The Justice Department says Alfozan, 35, had worked as an engineer at OpenAI since July 2025. He was arrested on October 9 and appeared in federal court on October 13, charged with using or attempting to use a device to intercept oral communications.
In a particularly ironic twist, prosecutors allege that a chatbot helped with the scheme. An account associated with Alfozan's spouse submitted questions about continuous recording, Wi-Fi connectivity, live listening, and encryption. Some prompts even referenced the device's unique MAC address.
Alfozan also allegedly used a productivity tool to locate executives and research meeting rooms and calendars. The targeted room hosted discussions about proprietary research, products, government engagements, and other sensitive matters.

articles.title: “L'ère nucléaire de la Nasa” : le vaisseau SR-1, propulsé par fission, part pour Mars dès 2028
articles.summary:
“L'ère nucléaire de la Nasa” : le vaisseau SR-1, propulsé par fission, part pour Mars dès 2028
Le patron de la Nasa, Jared Isaacman, annonce le virage nucléaire de son agence après un accord signé le 8 octobre. Le premier vaisseau interplanétaire propulsé par fission doit décoller pour Mars en 2028, et deux ans plus tard, un réacteur nucléaire devrait fournir de l'énergie sur la Lune.
La NASA déclare entrer dans une nouvelle ère nucléaire. Le 8 octobre, l'agence américaine a signé avec le département de l'Énergie (DOE) un accord destiné à accélérer le développement de systèmes nucléaires pour l'espace. Et derrière les annonces de réacteur lunaire et de missions lointaines, un engin concentre déjà cette ambition : Space Reactor-1 (SR-1) Freedom, qui doit partir vers Mars fin 2028.
	
L'ère nucléaire de la Nasa va permettre d'aller plus loin, de fonctionner plus longtemps et de déployer des engins et instruments plus performants que jamais.
We’re getting America underway on nuclear power in space and ushering in the era of a Nuclear NASA.

articles.title: Un « domaine stratégique » : Emmanuel Macron convoque un conseil de défense et sécurité sur l'IA
articles.summary:
L’intelligence artificielle s’invite au sommet de l’État. Ce mercredi 14 octobre, Emmanuel Macron a réuni un conseil de défense et de sécurité nationale entièrement consacré à l’IA, a annoncé l’Élysée. La réunion se tient à l’issue du Conseil des ministres. Pour l’Élysée, le sujet est désormais aussi stratégique que les industries spatiales ou nucléaires.
« À l’instar du spatial et du nucléaire, l’intelligence artificielle est devenue un domaine stratégique qui soulève des enjeux majeurs de sécurité nationale et de souveraineté », souligne l’Élysée dans un communiqué de presse.
Pour rappel, un conseil de défense et de sécurité nationale est une réunion restreinte qui rassemble les plus hauts responsables civils et militaires du pays. Présidée par le chef de l’État, elle permet d’aborder les questions les plus sensibles en matière de défense et de sécurité. Autour de la table de ce premier conseil consacré à l’IA, on retrouvera notamment le Premier ministre Sébastien Lecornu, la ministre des Armées Catherine Vautrin, et le chef d’état-major des Armées, le général Fabien Mandon.

articles.summary:
Tuesday, October 13th 2026
NVIDIA DLSS 5 Gets 2x Performance Boost with 20% Less VRAM Usage
NVIDIA's continuous optimization of software and its technology stack has yielded another great improvement. The latest DLSS 5 update, scheduled for October 16, will deliver another 2x performance boost, meaning that previously DLSS 5-optimized workloads will literally run twice as fast. Alongside this significant performance uplift, NVIDIA promises that in 4K gameplay with DLSS 5 enabled, the neural rendering technology will use 20% less VRAM, leaving more room for game textures to load without DLSS 5 interfering with capacity or hogging resources. NVIDIA updates its DLSS by running a continuous loop on top of an internal supercomputer that constantly optimizes DLSS technology for performance, efficiency, and visual fidelity. Specifically for this week's DLSS 5 update, NVIDIA states that the company used a combination of systematic pipeline optimizations and neural model refinements to achieve that 2x performance boost.
Originally in late August, we saw that the leaked DLSS 5 file was roughly a 148 million parameter model. Our analysis turned out to be accurate, and we see that, according to NVIDIA, the DLSS 5 October update shrinks the footprint of this model by another 24% to roughly 118 million parameters, meaning that our original estimation was correct. articles.title: Data sovereignty strains best-of-breed AI pipelines - SiliconANGLE
articles.summary:
Vast Data bets stitched-together AI pipelines can’t keep sensitive data in sync
Data sovereignty is becoming an architectural problem as enterprises push artificial intelligence inference toward their most sensitive information. Pipelines assembled from separate tools struggle to keep embeddings, permissions and source data aligned, leaving many valuable data sets out of AI’s reach.
The shift from model training to inference is changing what AI infrastructure has to deliver, and it has fueled demand for Vast Data Inc., which raised about $1 billion at a $30 billion valuation in April 2026. Platforms built for scale and speed now must also handle user identification, access control and regulated data, according to Vaughn Stewart (pictured), vice president of systems engineering at Vast.
“There’s kind of different philosophical concepts in the market, right? One is the bespoke model … a best-in-breed of every piece in an agentic pipeline,” Stewart said. “And what we see there is just too much exposure to having data that’s maybe not in sync between being updated versus the vector embeddings, or maybe not in sync between the user access controls on the source data versus what’s provided through an inference query.”

articles.title: SAC terá de atender 80% das chamadas em até 20 segundos • Tecnoblog
articles.summary:
SAC terá de atender 80% das chamadas em até 20 segundos
Decreto do governo exige acesso facilitado a atendentes humanos e também facilita o cancelamento de serviços.
Uma nova mudança nas regras para SAC no Brasil estabelece que pelo menos 80% das chamadas que solicitarem atendimento humano sejam atendidas em até 20 segundos. Nos demais casos, o prazo máximo é de cinco minutos. A norma foi definida pelo Decreto nº 13.135/2026, publicado pelo Governo Federal nesta terça-feira (13/10), e revoga o “Decreto do SAC” de 2022.
A medida também define condições para o uso de IA e outros sistemas automatizados e a facilitação do cancelamento dos serviços. As novas regras entram em vigor em novembro e serão fiscalizadas pela Secretaria Nacional do Consumidor (Senacon). Mais cedo, o governo também publicou medidas para facilitar a fiscalização de celulares em presídios.
As empresas poderão continuar usando chatbots, assistentes virtuais e sistemas de inteligência artificial para fazer triagens, encaminhar solicitações e resolver demandas. Porém, precisarão garantir uma opção de atendimento por uma pessoa:
Ao solicitar o atendimento humano, o consumidor deve ser informado sobre o tempo estimado de espera e a empresa não pode exigir que o cliente reexplique um problema já registrado. Ficam proibidas, também, mensagens publicitárias em qualquer etapa do SAC, inclusive durante o tempo de espera.

La comparación inevitable surge con el iPad mini, ya que, una vez desplegado, el plegable se acerca más a un tablet que a un teléfono convencional.

La diferencia es mínima en términos numéricos, y ambos dispositivos están pensados para el consumo de contenido visual.
En portabilidad, los dos modelos ocupan un lugar particular dentro del ecosistema Apple. El iPad mini ya se distingue por ser más manejable que un iPad convencional, pero el Duo lleva ese concepto un paso más allá: al plegarse, se transforma en un teléfono de apenas 11,3 milímetros de grosor.

Selon plusieurs sources industrielles qui ont partagé l’information à GamesBeat, les joueurs PC n’auraient pas à patienter trop longtemps, puisque la date de sortie du portage serait planifiée entre janvier et mars 2027.
Un calendrier bousculé pour rentabiliser un budget colossal
Avec un coût de production pour GTA VI estimé à plus de deux milliards de dollars, Rockstar Games a tout intérêt à élargir son audience le plus vite possible. Les joueurs sur ordinateur représentent un marché important pour maximiser les revenus du jeu, surtout face à un calendrier du premier trimestre 2027 déjà bien rempli par d’autres sorties importantes comme Metroid Ravenous, Until Dawn 2 ou encore Fable, pour ne citer qu’eux.
Ce délai assez court entre la sortie sur console et sur PC n’est pourtant pas vraiment dans les habitudes de l’éditeur. On se souvient par exemple de GTA V qui était sorti sur PS3 et Xbox 360 en septembre 2013, mais qui n’était arrivé sur PC qu’en avril 2015, soit une longue attente d’un an et sept mois. articles.title: NVIDIA Unveils "Preset C "DLSS Frame Generation with up to 35% Faster Generation
articles.summary:
Tuesday, October 13th 2026
NVIDIA Unveils "Preset C "DLSS Frame Generation with up to 35% Faster Generation
NVIDIA has updated its DLSS Frame Generation algorithm to be faster and more efficient. In the latest NVIDIA App beta update, rolling out today, the company introduced "Preset C," the fastest Performance Mode for DLSS Frame Generation. NVIDIA demonstrates that this mode can make frame generation up to 35% faster on the GeForce RTX 5060, with minimal trade-offs in image quality. This improvement applies to the GeForce RTX 40-Series, GeForce RTX 50-Series, and RTX Spark.
According to NVIDIA, there are two models for DLSS: Multi-Frame Generation and Frame Generation. The first model uses a standard AI approach that inputs motion vectors and depth to understand how two rendered frames are constructed. The second model employs optical flow for in-game elements like UI and ray tracing. Today, NVIDIA replaced this optical flow model with a much faster and lighter AI algorithm that boosts FPS across DLSS Frame Generation, Multi-Frame Generation, and Dynamic Multi-Frame Generation. Qué fue Roja Directa y por qué perdió vigencia
El sitio ganó notoriedad al reunir enlaces a transmisiones en vivo de partidos y eventos deportivos. Esa función generó una fuerte disputa con las empresas propietarias de los derechos de emisión, que vieron en la plataforma una amenaza directa a su modelo de negocio.
La oposición de ligas, productoras y operadores de televisión se tradujo en acciones judiciales y bloqueos constantes contra los distintos dominios asociados a Roja Directa. Con el paso del tiempo, la presión judicial fue en aumento.
Los accesos al sitio comenzaron a bloquearse desde distintos países y proveedores de internet, lo que generó una marcada inestabilidad en su funcionamiento.

En 2025, les datacenters représentaient environ 2,5% de l'électricité consommée dans la plupart des grands marchés européens. Selon une étude de Moody's, rapportée par The Register, cette part pourrait grimper dans plusieurs pays du Vieux Continent d'ici 2035.

La France et le Royaume-Uni devraient atteindre au moins 5,7% de la demande d'électricité en 2035. L'Irlande est un cas à part : la part y est passée de 5% en 2015 à 23% en 2025. Nous rapportions en juillet 2024 que les datacenters irlandais absorbaient déjà 21% du courant du pays en 2023, soit plus que les foyers urbains (18%). Or, pour rester compétitive, l'Union européenne veut plus que tripler sa capacité en datacenters d'ici cinq à sept ans, avec des sites dans les pays nordiques et le sud du continent. Il faudra donc produire plus d'électricité et agrandir les réseaux.
Cette stratégie pèsera tout d'abord sur les gestionnaires de réseaux. It’s backed by CT Innovations, which led the round, alongside Cardumen, Mana VC and 91 Ventures, which joined as participating investors.
Each time a new AI agent is deployed, it knows nothing at all about the company that deployed it. Those agents have to learn everything about the company’s business processes and operations from scratch in a process that’s repeated again and again, racking up significant costs in terms of computing resources.
Business context is crucial to agentic operations. If an AI agent is going to be able to work autonomously for an organization without constant human oversight, it needs to be well versed in the way that company operates.
That means knowledge of its operations, its historical decisions and so on. Until now, the only way agents could obtain this context was to reconstruct it from scratch with each new deployment, and that in turn means paying the model provider for each token used in that relearning process.

Ce dock est capable de remplacer la batterie d’un drone de façon autonome, en seulement 25 secondes. Pour être plus précis, le DJI Dock 4 supporte un drone spécifique : le Matrice 5TD. Celui-ci se révèle être un concentré de technologies qui, couplé au DJI Dock 4, promet d’amener de nouveaux standards dans le secteur des opérations aériennes continues. Il ne s’agit donc pas ici d’appareils grand public.

articles.title: ¿Se puede aprovechar el agua caliente de los océanos para generar electricidad? Un proyecto en Canarias quiere demostrar que sí
articles.summary:
Nuestro planeta es una gigantesca fuente de energía. Aunque ya sabíamos que las olas de los mares tienen un gran potencial como energía renovable, un no tan novedoso método maremotérmico quiere utilizar la diferencia de temperatura entre la superficie y el fondo oceánico para generar electricidad de forma continua, las 24 horas del día.
Y parece que Canarias tiene todas las papeletas para beneficiarse de esta tecnología.
El océano tiene varias temperaturas. El Sol, al igual que en la costa, calienta la superficie del océano. En algunas zonas, especialmente en las zonas tropicales, la temperatura del agua más cercana a la superficie puede ser mucho más alta que la de las profundidades: según la estadounidense Energy Information Administration, este contraste térmico puede alcanzar los 20 ºC de diferencia.
El aprovechamiento de esta diferencia tiene el nombre de conversión de energía térmica oceánica (OTEC, por sus siglas en inglés) y no es una idea nueva como tal: como cuentan desde Infobae, hace ya 140 años que se explora el potencial que tiene el océano para proporcionar energía limpia. De acuerdo con lo que indicaba un informe de 2021 del National Laboratory of the Rockies que recoge El Periódico de la Energía, solo usando las aguas que rodean Estados Unidos, la OTEC podría satisfacer la demanda eléctrica de todo el país.

Une directive européenne de 2018 sur les communications électroniques, transposée en 2021, impose seulement que l’autoradio, s’il y en a un, capte le DAB+, la radio numérique terrestre. Le texte répond à un appel lancé fin septembre par Radio France, l’Alliance de la radio, qui réunit les radios privées, et les radios associatives. « Plusieurs constructeurs commercialisent aujourd’hui des véhicules dépourvus de récepteur FM et DAB+, ou proposent la radio en option payante », déploraient-elles dans un communiqué commun. L’enjeu est de taille pour le secteur : d’après le rapport du Sénat, 35 % de l’écoute de la radio se fait en voiture, alors que l’audience a reculé de 18 % entre 2015 et 2025.

articles.title: Low-Cost Android Phones Ship With Preinstalled Malware That Turns Them Into Residential Proxies

Low-cost Android smartphones have been shipped with malicious software baked into the device firmware, allowing bad actors to covertly install apps, conduct ad fraud, and turn devices into residential proxies.
The activity, which targets Android devices built on MediaTek platforms across several brands, is being tracked by Bitdefender under the moniker Midnight Mimosa.
The preinstalled malware ("com.android.system.lite") runs with system-level privileges, which make it possible to install or uninstall a rotating set of at least 32 disguised apps, grant itself additional permissions to accessibility services, notifications, and SMS, and load arbitrary code supplied remotely by the operators.
Specifically, it fetches a remote configuration from an external server and then downloads and executes additional payloads designed to conduct ad fraud and silent installation or removal of partner apps. These apps incorporate proxyware, ad fraud, and code execution features. It can also grant permission to any Android app package.
"This essentially means its operators could install and delete apps at will, tuning each device to their needs, including making them part of large botnets," the Romanian cybersecurity company said.
"This scheme is likely designed mainly to generate revenue. The operators carry out ad and click fraud, collect device and installed-app information, and turn infected devices into residential-proxy relay nodes, making them zombies in botnets."
